note: Newspaper and periodical subscriptions (docs/newspaper-subscriptions-2026-11), written 20-Nov-2026 against the code on the feature branch. Added to test-cases.xlsx / tests/qa/catalog by scripts/qa/plan_workbook.py add-json.

features.feature: Newspaper and periodical subscriptions: title list, nearby vendor, grouped submission, day-of-month schedules, vendor notice and subscriber list

scenarios.title: Subscribe to newspapers and magazines from a vendor near you
scenarios.description: The customer picks one or more titles, chooses an address, is shown nearby vendors who deliver there and carry the titles, and submits once; the vendor is told and sees the subscriber.

cases.title: The newspaper and magazine list is public
cases.expected: 200 with every title: newspapers first, then magazines; each has a name, kind (NEWSPAPER / MAGAZINE), language, publication (DAILY / WEEKLY / FORTNIGHTLY / MONTHLY) and a default schedule (daily paper every day, weekly on its issue day, fortnightly on the 1st and 15th, monthly on the 1st). The starter list has dailies in English, Hindi and Marathi and at least one weekly and one monthly magazine.

cases.title: Finding vendors and subscribing need a signed-in customer
cases.steps:
1. As a guest, GET /api/subscriptions/newspapers/vendors?addressId=<any>&productIds=<any>
2. As a guest, POST /api/subscriptions/newspapers with a plausible body
cases.expected: Both answer 401 UNAUTHENTICATED before reading the request; nothing is created.

cases.title: A guest opening Newspapers & magazines is sent to sign-in
cases.expected: The guest lands on the sign-in page (next=/subscriptions/newspapers); no title list or vendor is shown.

cases.title: Vendors near the address who carry the chosen titles are shown, most titles first
cases.preconditions: Shop A lists two titles online with a price (category Newspapers / Magazines & Periodicals carried). Customer 1's default address is inside shop A's delivery area.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as customer 1
2. Open Newspapers & magazines, tick the two titles, keep the default address
3. Click Find vendors
cases.expected: Shop A is listed with both titles and their prices per copy and "2 of 2 titles"; a vendor who carries only one is listed after it with the title it does not sell named; a shop that does not deliver to the address is not listed.

cases.title: Several titles from one vendor are subscribed in one submission
cases.steps:
1. Choose shop A
2. Keep 1 copy of the daily paper, every day; set the magazine to Days of the month, 1st
3. Start tomorrow
4. Click Subscribe to 2 titles
cases.expected: 201: two subscriptions to shop A sharing one bundle id, one per title, with the chosen copies and schedule (DAILY; MONTHLY [1]). My Subscriptions shows both ("1 copy / delivery", the magazine badged "1st of the month") and the message "Your newspaper subscriptions are set up". Nothing is charged until a delivery day.

cases.title: The vendor is told at once and sees the subscriber
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as shop A's owner
2. Open Notifications
3. Open Orders > Subscribers (/shop/manage/subscribers)
cases.expected: One notice "New subscriber — 2 items" naming the customer, each title with copies and schedule, the start date and the delivery area, linking to Subscribers. Subscribers lists the customer once per title with the address, copies, schedule, start date and status Active, marked New; the per-item totals count them. A single milk subscription also gives the shop a "New subscriber" notice.

cases.title: A bad item refuses the whole submission
cases.steps: 1. POST /api/subscriptions/newspapers with: a day of the month 30; 11 copies; a title listed by another shop; a shop that does not deliver to the address; a product that is not a newspaper or magazine
cases.expected: Each answers 422 with a reason (days 1-28; copies 1-10; every title from the chosen vendor; the vendor does not deliver to the address; not available for subscription). No subscription and no vendor notice is created.

cases.title: A day-of-month magazine is delivered and charged only on its day
cases.preconditions: A daily paper and a monthly magazine subscribed together, wallet funded.
cases.steps:
1. Run the daily subscription job on the magazine's day
2. Run it on the next day
cases.expected: Day 1: two orders (paper and magazine), wallet charged copies x price for each. Day 2: only the paper's order. Milk and weekly subscriptions behave as before.
